title: ever AMOUR|Elegant Chiffon V-Neckline Long Sleeve Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elegant evening long dress with v-neckline and long flutter sleeves is a perfect wear for any event, making it perfect for wearing with your favorite accessories. Hone this stunning long sleeve formal gown to look fabulous at a wedding, graduation party, or prom. Our classic v-neckline chiffon evening gown with a beaded belt is the best choice for you! Grace yourself in a beautiful long sleeve evening gown on any occasion you want this fall.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
